app.name: Hearthvale
app.long_description: Rekindle the Great Hearth of Emberwick. Level ten skills - woodcutting, mining, fishing, herbalism, smithing, cooking, carpentry, alchemy, warrior and mage - in a stylized cel-shaded vale. Play with a GameCube controller (port 1) or a Classic Controller. Saves to SD:/apps/hearthvale/. Press HOME to save and exit.
